name: DVinyl
description: A self-hosted, plugin based collection manager for your Vinyls, CDs, Books, Movies, Games and LEGO sets.

paths.name: Uploads Volume
paths.description: Directory to store uploaded files like covers.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port DVinyl will be accessible on.

variables.name: MongoDB URL
variables.description: Connection string for your MongoDB instance. Replace with your MongoDB container IP or Unraid IP if hosted on the same custom network.

variables.name: JWT Password
variables.description: Password used for JWT token encryption.

variables.name: HTTPS Production Mode
variables.description: Change to true ONLY if you use HTTPS via a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Vinyl Port Variable
variables.description: Internal port variable required by the app.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for serving on a sub-path, leave empty to serve from root.

variables.name: Discogs API Token
variables.description: Your Discogs API Token for Vinyls/CDs.

variables.name: Hardcover API Key
variables.description: Your Hardcover API Key for Books.

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Your TMDB API Key for DVDs.

variables.name: Twitch Client ID
variables.description: Your Twitch Client ID for Games.

variables.name: Twitch Client Secret
variables.description: Your Twitch Client Secret for Games.

variables.name: Rebrickable API Key
variables.description: Your Rebrickable API Key for LEGO sets.

variables.name: OIDC Issuer URL
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Your OIDC provider issuer URL (Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, pocketID...). Leave empty to disable SSO.

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. The client ID registered on your OIDC provider.

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. The client secret registered on your OIDC provider.

variables.name: OIDC Redirect URI
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Must exactly match the callback registered on your provider, always ending with /login/oidc/callback.

variables.name: OIDC Button Label
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Text shown on the SSO login button, for example 'Sign in with Authentik'.
